senses.gloss: अदृश्यता अ-दृश्य + ता (vb. दृश्), f. Invisibility, Bhartṛ. 1, 95.
अ- + दृष्टि अ- + दृष्टि, f. a look of displeasure.

अ-दृष्ट- + पुरुष अ-दृष्ट- + पुरुष (vb. दृश्), adj. (viz. संधि), a kind of alliance where one party alone settles for the other, on the condition that the enemy has to disburse the expenses of the expedition, Hit. iv. d. 117.

अ-दृष्ट- + पूर्व अ-दृष्ट- + पूर्व (vb. दृश्),
 I. adj. not seen before, Rām. 5, 54, 3.
